classificationPolicy.DISTILLERY: A physical whisky distillery or a directory label that deterministically resolves to one physical distillery.
classificationPolicy.INDEPENDENT_BOTTLER: A bottler/merchant that selects or bottles spirit made at another distillery.
classificationPolicy.BRAND/PRODUCER: A commercial whisky brand, range, or producer umbrella that is not itself one single exact physical distillery identity.
classificationPolicy.UNDISCLOSED_DISTILLERY: A product/pseudonymous identity where the actual source distillery is deliberately or operationally undisclosed.
classificationPolicy.REVIEW_REQUIRED: The raw entity is ambiguous, duplicated, historical, or otherwise unsafe to resolve without Founder review or targeted research.
